core_obligations: Choose I^* K-injective representing M and L^* K-flat representing L; the identity SheafHom^*(K^*, SheafHom^*(L^*,I^*)) = SheafHom^*(Tot(K^*  otimes  L^*), I^*) holds by the compose lemma (proof lines 10614-10623).

The left side represents R SheafHom(K, R SheafHom(L,M)) (from-K-flat-into-K-injective lemma) and the right side represents R SheafHom(K  otimes ^L L, M); this proves the displayed formula (proof lines 10624-10634).
Taking global sections and using the section-RHom-over-U lemma gives (equation-internal-hom) (proof lines 10635-10637).

Read off the two representations and take global sections.
